'''Gunjack''' was a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] variant made of a highly concentrated methylpenatox and glucose based chemical cocktail. Consumption of Gunjack granted the user intense physical strength, but also decreased the user's fine motor control and the ability to reason.

==Behind the scenes==
Gunjack was a spice craftable by [[:w:c:swg:Smuggler|smugglers]] in [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]. It was removed from the game along with most other spices with the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]" in [[2005]].
